sigs.fullName: ISCA Special Interest Group on Russian Speech Analysis
sigs.description: Based at the Phonetics Department of St. Petersburg State University, SIGRU promotes research on Russian speech analysis, particularly formal representations of the Russian sound system to enable automatic processing of large speech corpora and phonetic/linguistic interpretation of speech events.
